subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Which public model fallback contract should OpenClaw support for provider-family failover: wildcard/auto refs, fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallbacks, or explicit fallbacks only?
rationale: This is a provider/model routing and config-contract choice with cost, auth, and upgrade implications, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent public surface.

options.title: Choose one core fallback contract
options.body: Define a single supported contract before implementation so schema, runtime, docs, and doctor behavior do not drift across competing fallback meanings.

options.title: Narrow to catalog-derived fallbacks
options.body: Use the fallbacksFromModels direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 and leave wildcard/auto plus fallbackFamilies out of scope for now.

options.title: Keep explicit fallbacks only
options.body: Reject new fallback config for now and document provider/* allowlists plus explicit fallbacks as the supported operator workflow.

recommendation.title: Choose one core fallback contract
recommendation.body: Define a single supported contract before implementation so schema, runtime, docs, and doctor behavior do not drift across competing fallback meanings.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is central model fallback resolver and schema ownership around the affected surface.
